description: We are Team XOF a crew of full stack AI and software engineers passionate about orbital mechanics real time telemetry and space systems design. For the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge we built KAIROS a deterministic Lunar South Pole mission simulator and 360 degree NASA LOLA crater horizon raycaster that rescues delayed Artemis landings in 15 milliseconds. Our skills span TypeScript React physics modeling and UI design to turn complex NASA data into intuitive mission tools.
